independent_static_SDK_checks: nn::aoc::Initialize at sdk+0x1dd600 calls InitializeForHipc at sdk+0x1ddb00; it opens and wraps aoc:u at sdk+0x1ddd28, stores the service at SDK global0xbacc78 and increments its reference count. It sends no AOC command during this initializer

CountAddOnContent wrapper sdk+0x1dd630 -> virtual0x20 -> sdk+0x1ddf44 selects cmd2. Transfer helper sdk+0x1de284 writes raw u64 ClientProcessId placeholder0, sdk+0x1de270 sets sendPID, sdk+0x1de30c reads u32 count

ListAddOnContent wrapper sdk+0x1dd680 -> virtual0x28 -> sdk+0x1ddf50 selects cmd3. Raw arguments are u32 offset,u32 count,u64 ClientProcessId placeholder0, with sendPID; sdk+0x1de3b8/0x1de3bc writes B1 HIPC header0x01000006 and sdk+0x1de438/0x1de43c writes raw arguments. Output buffer capacity is count*4, output raw count is u32

PID-aware list-changed event wrapper sdk+0x1dd940 -> virtual0x50 -> sdk+0x1ddfc0 selects cmd10, with raw u64 ClientProcessId placeholder0 and sendPID. Transfer helper sdk+0x1de8ac returns readable COPY handle; SDK AttachSystemEvent at sdk+0x1dd98c uses autoclear1
Count/List/Event wrappers are statically measured available calls, not commands observed in boot5. The observed runtime gate was service acquisition only

host_policy.inventory: immutable empty runtime-visible add-on-content inventory for the prepared base game/update v1.1.0; no DLC has been installed or mounted through this host
host_policy.entitlement_limit: No account, purchase entitlement, ownership license or external installed-content catalog is queried or inferred. A separately present small DLC input is not considered installed or mounted
host_policy.scope: single current application only; no arbitrary-application queries, content preparation, mounting, purchasing, installation or dynamic inventory updates

implemented.service: actual aoc:u registered with the existing generic IPC service manager; a real MOVE session is returned, with one process-lifetime immutable policy state
implemented.CountAddOnContent2: sendPID plus raw u64 placeholder0; returns exactly u32 count0
implemented.ListAddOnContent3: sendPID plus raw u32 offset,u32 count,u64 placeholder0 and exactly one output B MapAlias descriptor; validates requested index capacity, nonempty address and address overflow, returns exactly u32 written0 at every offset and performs no output-buffer writes
implemented.GetAddOnContentListChangedEventWithProce: sendPID plus raw u64 placeholder0; returns exactly one fresh readable COPY handle and no raw data. One service-owned writable event is allocated lazily; initially and persistently unsignaled because this adapter exposes no inventory mutations. Client SDK attaches its copy with autoclear1
implemented.lifetime: generic IPC domain/clone support remains in ipc.c; clones borrow the process-lifetime state, and closing readable copies leaves the service-owned event alive
implemented.guards: checked host scratch required at service open and commands; CMIF4/6 only, expected PID descriptor and zero ClientProcessId placeholder, bounded raw widths with unspecified alignment slack, no unmeasured handles or buffer types; unknown commands fail explicitly
implemented.pre_main: constructor only registers the service; no environment, profile, inventory or event access before main

unsupported: legacy GetAddOnContentListChangedEvent8; only this SDK's measured PID-aware cmd10 is implemented
GetAddOnContentBaseId, PrepareAddOnContent, mount/unmount notifications, purchasing and entitlement interfaces
arbitrary application ID discovery, DLC content/filesystem installation or access, dynamic content inventory changes
all other commands; they fail with exact service/command diagnostics instead of blanket success

validation.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_aoc_ipc.py -v
validation.test_boundaries: actual C HIPC/CMIF, service manager, session handles, events, CloseHandle and WaitSynchronization; guest entry/TLS/symbol calls abort if reached. No game/SDK/DLC/GPU input is executed or read by tests
cases: pre-main registration without environment or event creation
actual service-manager GetServiceHandle returns a real moved aoc:u session
Count result is exactly u32 zero, with consistent List zero results
actual HIPC B descriptor decodes to the expected output address and capacity; empty List preserves all caller sentinel bytes
zero-capacity and out-of-range offset List calls return no entries
fresh readable COPY event handles start unsignaled, remain valid when another copy closes, and 1000 query/close iterations retain service state
actual WaitSynchronization times out for unchanged inventory; queries do not invent content-change notifications
domain Count and event COPY output; cloned session retains policy after original close
missing PID, extra handles/buffers, unsupported transport, nonzero PID placeholder, truncated input and missing run guard fail
List rejects missing B descriptor, undersized capacity and address overflow
unmeasured prepare, purchase, mount, legacy event and unknown commands fail
validation.independent_peer_review: focused read-only source/test review found no material issue; peer did not execute tests
